[33459074] The mean of GFR-estimates based on serum creatinine (eGFRcrea) and cystatin C (eGFRcys) has superior accuracy than each estimate alone. [33459074] In a broad pediatric nephrological population, |ΔeGFR| is below 40% in the vast majority of measurements. [33459074]
